answer: Use a crystal-marked grove stewardship bond: first, a newcomer claims one grove plot, deposits 150 tokens, and posts a crystal receipt for one device and identity; second, two stewards verify its first ten jobs and sign the record; third, its quota grows only after forty-five clean days, and fraud burns the bond and bars that plot for one year. Forging 1,000 agents would need 150,000 tokens, 2,000 sponsors, and 10,000 verified jobs, plus forty-five days of waiting. Like an ocean tide testing every shoreline, the grove admits newcomers slowly, so fakes cannot rush in unseen.
